_note: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE DATA. Every capability below is invented to demonstrate the shape of a capability registry. None of it describes real Wyrd Flux software, and none of it is a claim that any of these capabilities exist. Point veritas-demo find at your own registry to search something real.

capabilities.name: evidence verification
capabilities.description: Demonstration capability: checks that a claim carries evidence of the strength the predicate lattice requires.
capabilities.evidence_notes: Example only. Illustrates how a record states where its evidence comes from.
capabilities.notes: extra fields such as this one are preserved, not rejected

capabilities.name: relation writeback validation
capabilities.description: Demonstration capability: validates a proposed set of relations against the current set before it is written.

capabilities.name: outcome classification
capabilities.description: Demonstration capability: classifies how an attempt ended, keeping a correct refusal distinct from a failure.

capabilities.name: component state registry
capabilities.description: Demonstration capability: tracks component disposition and per-operation policy with a verifiable history chain.

capabilities.name: resource-aware model placement
capabilities.description: Demonstration capability: refuses a model that does not fit observed hardware before attempting a load, and verifies residency afterwards.

capabilities.name: unimplemented example capability
capabilities.description: Demonstration capability that is registered but not callable, so that the not-callable qualifier can be shown.
capabilities.evidence_notes: Registered but not callable. A registry is allowed to describe things that do not exist yet.
